newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovak April PPI rises 0.6 pct month/month.
newsitem.headline: Slovak April PPI rises 0.6 pct month/month.

text.p: Slovak producer prices (PPI) rose 0.6 percent month-on-month in April 1997, putting prices 4.8 percent higher than in April 1996, the Slovak Statistical Bureau (SUSR) said in a statement on Monday.
The PPI decreased by 0.6 percent month-on-month in March 1997, making the year-on-year increase 4.2 percent.
Prices of industrial products increased by 0.7 percent month-on-month in April 1997, rising 4.8 percent against the same month last year.
Construction prices rose 0.8 percent in April 1997, up 9.5 percent year-on-year.
SUSR did not provide comparative figures for April 1996, saying it had begun calculating PPI according to European Union standards from the beginning of this year.
